title: Greif Vietnam Townhall Strengthens APAC Collaboration and Operational Excellence
summary: Greif recently hosted a regional leadership visit at its Vietnam facility, reinforcing the company's commitment to operational excellence, legendary customer
body_markdown:
Greif recently hosted a regional leadership visit at its Vietnam facility, reinforcing the company’s commitment to operational excellence, legendary customer service, and continuous improvement across the Asia Pacific region.


Led by Tan Peck Ling, General Manager, Steel APAC, the visit brought together leaders, colleagues and customers to discuss the priorities shaping the region’s future. Through plant tours, townhall conversations and customer meetings, the time together strengthened the connections between leadership and frontline operations.Our teams shared insights, aligned on region priorities, and reinforced their commitment to delivering the high level of service our customers have come to expect. The collaborative culture fostered among our teams across APAC during this townhall allows Greif to be the advantage that helps our customers win.


A key part of the visit was spending time on the production floor, where leaders saw safety, quality and efficiency initiatives in action. These first-hand interactions create valuable opportunities to exchange ideas, recognize successes and identify opportunities for continuous improvement across the regional network rather than solely reviewing performance in a meeting room.


Conversations with customers throughout the visit highlighted the importance of staying connected to changing market needs. By hearing customers’ direct concerns about evolving market dynamics, Greif can adapt its trusted, innovative, and tailored solutions to better address their priorities, support their growth, and strengthen its role as a trusted partner.While strategy and operations were central themes throughout the visit, the most memorable moments focused on recognizing the people who make Greif Vietnam successful. Just as importantly, the visit reinforced Greif’s strong connection to the region through the employees whose expertise, commitment, and customer focus continue to drive success across Vietnam.
